Recruiting body: UCO Bank, Head Office, 10 BTM Sarani, Kolkata – 700001
Post: Apprentice (one-year apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961)
Who can apply: Graduates (degree completed on or after 1 April 2022), aged 20–28 years as on 1 October 2026
Application mode: Online - register on the NATS portal, then pay the exam fee and submit details via BFSI SSC
Job location: Bank branches in the State/UT chosen by the candidate
Official Notification PDF: UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026
UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview
UCO Bank invites online applications from candidates for engagement as apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended). Candidates can apply for only one State/UT. Selection is through an online objective test conducted by the BFSI Sector Skill Council of India (BFSI SSC), followed by a local language test during document verification and a medical fitness check. Apprentices are trainees, not employees of the Bank, and have no right to employment after training.
A total of 530 apprentice seats are available across 31 States/UTs. The numbers are provisional and may vary with the Bank's actual requirement, and the Bank may allot a training location in any district of the selected State/UT. "OC", "HI", "VI" and "ID" below are the PwBD (benchmark disability) seats that fall within each State's total, not additional seats.
Abbreviations: SC – Scheduled Caste; ST – Scheduled Tribe; OBC (NCL) – Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer); EWS – Economically Weaker Section; UR – Unreserved; OC – Orthopedically/Locomotor disability category; HI – Hearing Impaired; VI – Visually Impaired; ID – Intellectual Disability. There is no reservation for Ex-servicemen/Disabled Ex-servicemen, and they are not engaged as apprentices.
Candidates must hold a graduate degree from a recognised University/Institute approved by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies. The graduation mark sheets and provisional/final degree certificate must have been issued on or after 1 April 2022 .
UCO Bank Apprentice Other Eligibility Conditions
Nationality: A citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before January 1962 to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or specified East African countries and Vietnam with the intention of settling in India (the last three categories need an eligibility certificate from the Government of India).
Candidates must not have undergone, or be currently undergoing, apprenticeship with UCO Bank or any other organisation, and apprentices terminated by their organisation are not eligible.
Candidates with training or job experience of one year or more after completing their educational qualification are not eligible.
Candidates applying for a particular State/UT must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding at least one local language of that State/UT. A language test is conducted during document verification; candidates who produce a 10th or 12th mark sheet showing they studied the local language are exempt.
Candidates may apply for only one State/UT; multiple applications will be rejected (only the last valid application is considered).
The age limit is a minimum of 20 years and a maximum of 28 years as on 1 October 2026 (the maximum applies to Unreserved and EWS candidates).
Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances or benefits. Daily training hours are as applicable to the Bank's clerical staff. Transport, hostel or any other residential accommodation is not provided.
The fee is paid online to BFSI SSC through the secure payment link in the application form, between 14 October and 29 October 2026. It is non-refundable under any circumstances, whether or not the candidate attends the test or is shortlisted, and cannot be adjusted against any other selection process.
The total duration is 60 minutes. The advertisement does not mention negative marking. The minimum qualifying marks out of 100 are 40 for General/EWS and 35 for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD . The merit list is prepared State-wise and category-wise in descending order of marks; ties are broken in favour of the older candidate.
Eligible applicants who have paid the fee receive an exam link and login credentials from BFSI SSC on the day before the exam.
The test is taken from the candidate's own residence, using their own camera-enabled desktop, laptop, tablet or smartphone, in isolation from other people (except PwBD candidates).
Candidates must display the Aadhaar card they uploaded on the NATS portal as ID proof for image capture.
Failure to register for the written test results in disqualification. Responses may be analysed for similarity patterns, and results of candidates whose scores are found not genuine can be withheld.
Local Language Test, Medical Fitness and Wait List
The local language test is held during document verification. Engagement is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit as per the Bank's requirement. The Bank may declare a wait list at its discretion to cover non-acceptance or non-reporting by selected candidates.
How to Apply for UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026
Applications are accepted online only; no hard copy of the application or documents is to be sent to the Bank. The process is:
Register on NATS: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme portal ( nats.education.gov.in , "Student Register/Login") and note your Enrolment ID.
Apply for UCO Bank's apprenticeship: After logging in, view the "UCO Bank" apprenticeship advertisement and apply for it on the portal, choosing one State/UT.
Check your email from BFSI SSC: Candidates who applied on NATS receive an email from BFSI SSC ( [email protected] ) inviting them to provide caste category, choice of districts for training, and other details, and to pay the fee.
Complete details and pay the fee: Submit the additional information and pay the online fee at beep.bfsissc.com by 29 October 2026. Details entered must match those on the NATS portal.
Upload documents: Upload the photograph, signature, date of birth proof, graduation certificates and other certificates as required by the apprenticeship portal or when advised by the Bank or BFSI SSC.
Appear for the online test: Take the test on 7 November 2026 using the link sent by email.
The candidate's name must be spelt exactly as in the certificates/mark sheets, percentage should be given to two decimals (CGPA must be converted to percentage), and no change is allowed after submission.
UCO Bank Apprentice Important Instructions
Candidates must have a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active until the engagement process is complete; call letters and intimations are sent by email/SMS only.
Original certificates for educational qualification, age and category must be produced at document verification, or candidature is cancelled.
OBC candidates need a non-creamy layer certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026; EWS candidates need an Income and Asset Certificate valid for FY 2026-27 (income of FY 2025-26); PwBD candidates need a disability certificate (UDID/certificates may be verified, and a medical board may reassess).
Apprentices are trainees, not employees; PF, ESI, bonus and other labour-law provisions do not apply, they may not join or form a union, and the Bank has no obligation to offer employment after training.
Candidates must execute a Contract of Apprenticeship before training begins; those who absent themselves may have to refund training costs and stipend received.
Travel costs for document verification are borne by the candidate. Requests for changes of contact details, address, email or test centre are not entertained.
Canvassing in any form is a disqualification. All disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the Courts at Kolkata.
All revisions and corrigenda will be published only on www.uco.bank.in (career section).

UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 FAQs
Q1. What is UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
It is Advertisement No. HO/HRM/RECR/2026-27/COM-02 from UCO Bank for the engagement of 530 apprentices for one year under the Apprentices Act, 1961, across 31 States/UTs.
Q2. How many vacancies are available in UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
There are 530 provisional seats: 106 SC, 49 ST, 147 OBC (NCL), 23 EWS and 205 UR. West Bengal has the most seats (86), followed by Uttar Pradesh (45) and Odisha (41).
Q3. What is the last date to apply for UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
The last date for registration, exam fee payment and submission of additional information is 29 October 2026.
Q4. What is the qualification required for UCO Bank Apprentice?
A graduate degree from a recognised University/Institute, with mark sheets and degree certificate issued on or after 1 April 2022.
Q5. What is the age limit for UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
20 to 28 years as on 1 October 2026, with relaxation for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10 to 15 years) and concessions for widows, divorced and legally separated women.
Q6. What is the UCO Bank Apprentice application fee?
₹200 plus GST for SC/ST and PwBD candidates; ₹800 plus GST for General/EWS/OBC male candidates; and ₹600 plus GST for General/EWS/OBC female and transgender candidates.
Q7. How can I apply online for UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
Register on the NATS portal, apply for UCO Bank's apprenticeship there, then complete details and pay the fee at beep.bfsissc.com by 29 October 2026, as described in the How to Apply section above.
Q8. What is the UCO Bank Apprentice selection process?
A 100-mark, 60-minute online objective test on 7 November 2026, a local language test at document verification, and a medical fitness check. The merit list is State-wise and category-wise.
Q9. What is the stipend for UCO Bank Apprentices?
₹16,650 per month, made up of ₹10,500 from UCO Bank and ₹6,150 government share through DBT.
